title: PatientWM: Towards Generalizable Clinical World Models via Unified Patient States
abstract: arXiv:2610.17059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical decisions depend on anticipating how a patient's condition will evolve as treatment is adjusted and new evidence becomes available. Existing medical world models capture patient-state evolution, but often define the evolving state around a particular modality or task, limiting reuse as inputs or prediction targets change. These models also retain history through observation sequences or recurrent or latent summaries rather than exposing preceding patient states and clinical actions as an ordered transition context. This distinction matters because similar current measurements may follow different recent changes, treatment exposures, and observed responses. To tackle these limitations, we propose PatientWM, a clinical world-model framework built around a unified patient state and sequential latent history. translated_title: PatientWM：通过统一患者状态迈向可泛化的临床世界模型
translated_abstract: 临床决策依赖于预测当治疗调整和新证据出现时患者病情将如何演变。现有的医学世界模型能够捕捉患者状态的演变，但通常围绕特定模态或任务来定义这一演变状态，这限制了当输入或预测目标发生变化时模型的复用性。此外，这些模型通过观测序列或循环/潜在摘要来保留历史信息，而不是将先前的患者状态和临床操作作为有序的转移上下文显式呈现。这一区别十分重要，因为相似的当前测量值可能是在不同的近期变化、治疗暴露和观察到的反应之后产生的。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了PatientWM，一个围绕统一患者状态和序列潜在历史构建的临床世界模型框架。可用性感知编码器将每个决策时刻可获得的观测数据整合到患者状态中，而类型化的解码…
tldr: 提出PatientWM临床世界模型框架，通过统一患者状态与序列潜在历史显式建模疾病演变和临床操作的转移上下文，使模型在输入模态或预测任务变化时仍具备泛化与复用能力。
en_tdlr: PatientWM is a clinical world-model framework built on a unified patient state and sequential latent history, enabling generalizable reuse across changing inputs, modalities, and prediction targets in clinical decision-making.
